technologyBasis.rule: Default general Ar'nock machinery to highly integrated solid-state/electromechanical functional modules with silicon computation and characteristic piezoelectric sensing/actuation. Biotechnology is secondary support technology unless a named subsystem source establishes an exception.

transitFamily.rule: Ar'nock species, modularity, silicon computation, piezoelectric technology and biological fabrication MUST NOT select or imply a transit family. Scenario-selected family associations remain MIXED.

traits: solid-state silicon is the primary general computation substrate
general machinery is solid-state/electromechanical and highly modular
complete functional assemblies are the normal field-service boundary
piezoelectric sensing, actuation, vibration analysis and resonant functions are characteristic
biological fabrication is advanced but primarily supports feedstock, medicine, environment and life support
elongated segmented body plan and vibration-oriented interfaces influence ergonomics

energy.state: Electrical energy is conditioned through replaceable conversion, switching, protection and buffer modules. Gross source power, protected recovery energy, thermal capacity and service-path integrity are independent readiness predicates.
limits: No Ar'nock-specific canonical FTL energy law or numerical power requirement is recovered.

geometry.state: Family-specific effect geometry is implemented through sectional replaceable modules and surveyed structural interfaces. Piezoelectric strain/alignment sensing can monitor geometry without replacing family-specific field measurements.
limits: Exact geometry depends on selected/recovered transit family and installation.

navigation.state: Transit-family sensing requirements remain physically authoritative. Ar'nock navigation defaults to solid-state silicon estimation and covariance processing with independent timing/reference chains and piezoelectric structural/inertial support channels where appropriate.
limits: Native coordinate representation, manufacturer doctrine and actual Ar'nock transit family remain unresolved.

control.state: Distributed solid-state regional controllers coordinate through deterministic data/command links, local interlocks and sectional isolation. Functional modules retain local identity, revision and calibration state.
limits: Exact bus technology, protocol and manufacturer connector standard remain unresolved.

recovery.state: Recovery combines family-specific exit/state disposal with protected electrical energy, thermal rejection, control continuity, structural alignment and verified recovery-module availability.
limits: No canonical Ar'nock recovery thresholds or times are recovered.

health.state: Condition-based module health, service-path health and refit provenance dominate maintenance. Biological-health monitoring is confined to actual biological support equipment or sourced exceptions.
limits: Internal repairability varies; high integration can make complete module replacement easier than component-level repair.

signature.state: Selected family signatures are supplemented by electrical switching spectra, converter harmonics, timing/reference activity, piezoelectric resonance/actuation, mechanical vibration and thermal rejection. Biochemical signatures belong primarily to support biotechnology unless specifically sourced to the installation.
limits: Machinery-basis signatures may not replace or contradict family-specific physical signatures.

infrastructure.state: No Ar'nock-specific beacon, corridor, gatework or fixed transit infrastructure class is currently confirmed.
limits: Do not infer gate use, prepared corridors or strategic infrastructure from modularity, silicon computation or bioprinting.

machineChain.energyConditioning: replaceable solid-state conversion, switching, isolation, protection and buffer modules
machineChain.primeMover: family-specific exotic initiating machinery packaged as serviceable functional modules where physically possible
machineChain.fieldFormation: sectional field-former/emitter/coupling modules with surveyed mechanical and electrical interfaces
machineChain.transitControl: distributed silicon control modules with redundant timing/reference, deterministic interlocks and local abort authority
machineChain.navigationSensing: family-required exotic sensors plus piezoelectric structural/alignment/inertial support diagnostics where appropriate
machineChain.terminationRecovery: family-specific termination plus protected electrical, thermal, control and structural recovery systems
machineChain.wholeEffectCoverage: surveyed modular coverage of actual hull, appendages, cargo and translated volume
machineChain.backbone: sectional buses, breakers, valves, local interlocks, protected stores, redundant command paths and module isolation

coverageGeometry.rule: Scale by increasing the number and hierarchy of replaceable field/control/power modules, service zones and local safety authorities rather than by simply enlarging one central machine.

distribution.probe: few highly integrated modules with limited redundancy
distribution.fighterOrShuttle: tight module packaging and rapid line replacement
distribution.frigateOrMerchant: redundant functional bays, cross-ties and local protected stores
distribution.cruiser: regional compute/control, field sectors and service graph isolation
distribution.capital: hierarchical modular provinces with local safety authority, redundant references and sectional recovery
distribution.gatework: UNRESOLVED; if future canon establishes Ar'nock gate use, treat it as industrial modular infrastructure, not a ship drive enlarged by size alone

parameters.A_e: normalized edge/service availability; not a probability

powerModel.safeguard: Peak source power is not equivalent to protected recovery energy; electrical availability is not equivalent to cooling, command or structural readiness.

navigationModel.safeguard: Translation retains uncertainty and evidence ancestry; piezoelectric structural data cannot be relabeled as direct measurement of an exotic FTL state.

spatialRules: controls may occupy vertical, circumferential or multi-reach surfaces suited to elongated segmented limbs
vibration-based input is naturally compatible with piezoelectric mechanically coupled interfaces
computation is distributed across solid-state modules rather than biological ganglia
service access is organized around replaceable functional modules and their power/data/cooling/structural interfaces
controlModel.abortRule: Mechanism-specific abort semantics outrank machinery style; modular controls cannot manufacture post-commit steering or abort authority forbidden by family physics.

maintenanceModel.philosophy: condition-based module replacement with event-triggered calibration and recertification
humanSalvageProcedure: identify functional module boundaries before opening sealed assemblies
measure electrical, thermal, vibration and signal state non-destructively
map power, data, cooling and structural interfaces separately
preserve module identity, revision, calibration and location provenance
prefer verified module substitution over speculative internal component repair
compare latency and calibration after replacement
recertify the affected service graph and family-specific safety function

forensic.rule: Electrical, thermal, vibration and module-state evidence supplement rather than replace family-specific forensic evidence.

modalities.electromagnetic: DERIVED supporting channel plus family-dependent components
modalities.phaseOrQ: family-dependent; never infer Q use from species alone
modalities.topological: family-dependent; never infer fold/gate use from species alone
modalities.biochemical: support-biotechnology dependent; not a generic drive signature

failureModel.composition: F_instance = F_family tensor F_basis tensor F_species tensor F_condition
failureModel.rule: Combine applicable machinery faults with the selected transit family's actual hazard mechanism; never emit a generic biological malfunction or one generic FTL consequence across all families.

infrastructureModel.safeguard: Generic Black Light infrastructure classes are available to a caller/scenario but are not Ar'nock canon without a source assignment.

documentationViews.principle: One structured resolved installation drives textual, diagrammatic and API views so manuals, education, intelligence reporting and generators cannot silently diverge.
diagramModels: technology authority -> solid-state modular basis -> route semantics -> eight-block embodiment -> selected family
sensor modules -> silicon estimators -> arbitration modules -> field/actuator modules -> protected recovery
detect -> localize module -> isolate -> replace -> restore calibration -> sectional test -> recertify

canonSafeguards: Do not assign an Ar'nock transit family from species or technology-basis evidence.
Do not treat Ar'nock technology as generically biological, symbiotic, cultivated-neural or metabolic.
Bioprinting is not evidence that computation, propulsion or control machinery is biological.
Default general computation to solid-state silicon and machinery to modular solid-state/electromechanical assemblies.
Piezoelectric support channels may not be promoted into family-specific exotic sensing without evidence.
Do not invent manufacturer names, Path levels, tiers, performance, range, spool time, recovery time, connector standards or chronology capability.
A caller-selected family creates a MIXED hypothetical Ar'nock embodiment, not confirmed species canon.
Legacy biological-default references are superseded by data/blacklight-continuum/wiki/arnock-technology-authority.json where they conflict.
